comment: PreToolUse safety hooks for yotta-code-quality. Blocks obviously dangerous commands before they run. Compatible with Claude Code / Codex hook schema (PreToolUse on Bash). Adapt the matcher to your agent's hook format if needed.

hooks.command: node -e "const c=process.env.BASH_COMMAND||(process.argv[2]||'');const deny=[/rm\s+-rf?\s+\//,/rm\s+-rf?\s+[A-Za-z]:\\?\\?/,/git\s+push\s+--force/,/git\s+push\s+-f\b/,/git\s+reset\s+--hard/,/git\s+clean\s+-[a-z]*[fdx]/,/mkfs/,/:\(\)\s*\{\s*:\|:\|/,/dd\s+if=/,/chmod\s+-R\s+777\s+\//];if(deny.some(r=>r.test(c))){console.error('[yotta-code-quality] BLOCKED dangerous command by policy: '+c);process.exit(1);}process.exit(0);"
